tay-khong.title: Close-Combat Self-Defence

dong-doi.sub: Hand signals, short and clear comms, movement formations and covering each other in airsoft and paintball.

so-cuu.sub: Stopping bleeding, applying a tourniquet, pressure bandages, treating shock, CPR, and first aid with few supplies.
